alex: Quick heads up — releasebus operator handoff for engine cutover tonight 23:30 UTC. We need final pin decisions, rollback criteria and a 1-line release note. Can folks sync? :wave:
maya: On call for cutover. Morning checks passed. What's the pin TTL we want?
sam: Suggest pin engine-quant:v5.2 -> TTL 4h, fallback to engine-quant:v5.1. Metrics to watch: p95 latency, kvcache-miss-rate, OOMs. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
alex: Agreed. Also add 'if p95 > 350ms for 5m or OOM rate >0.5% -> immediate rollback' — is that too aggressive?
lia: That seems fine. Add deployment window note: don't exceed 2% traffic slice per 2 minutes. We'll ramp 0.5%,1%,2%.
deploy-bot: depbot: starting rollout plan created: `/rollout create engine-quant:v5.2 --slices 0.5,1,2 --fallback engine-quant:v5.1 --pin-ttl 4h`
glen: Ops note: region-eu has some thermal sims earlier — recommend exclude eu-west-2 from first slice.
maya: Good catch. Update rollout to skip eu-west-2 for slice 0.5. I'll adjust deploy command.
maya: `/rollout update --skip-region eu-west-2 --slice 0.5`
deploy-bot: depbot: rollout updated. planID rbus-174451
sam: Release notes blurb draft: 'Engine runtime: quant kernel update improves matmul throughput; reduces token p99 on long prompts. Rolling upgrade with fallback to v5.1.'
alex: Shorten: 'Runtime: quant kernel update -> improved long prompt throughput. Canary rollout with fallback to v5.1.' Sounds good?
lia: Add note about config flip: 'enable-kv-prefetch=true' that will be toggled in rollout. Ops confirmed.
alex: We need a clear rollback play: who hits the rollback button and what command?
maya: On-call can hit rollback if pager fires or manual console shows OOM spike. Command: `/rollout abort rbus-174451`
glen: Also add quick-rollforward steps in case rollout aborts accidentally — don't want stuck pins. Steps: unpin then re-deploy fallback.
alex: I'll add that to the release note. Also cc @oncall for the night shift.
deploy-bot: depbot: scheduled rollout to start 2024-11-03T23:30:00Z (rbus-174451). Notification sent to channel #eng-runtime.
oncall: Received. We'll monitor p50/p95/p99, eviction counts, and kv cache hitrate. We'll post green/red every 5m during ramp.
sam: One more: perf-flags on v5.2 are behind a feature flag. Make sure canary uses FF OFF for first slice then ON?
maya: Plan: slice 0.5 -> FF=OFF, slice 1% -> FF=ON, 2% -> ON. That helps isolate.
alex: All set. If no objections in 15m we'll proceed to preflight smoke at 22:45 UTC and bake window at 23:30. :rocket:
lia: ack. pushing release note to release-bus: 'rbus-174451: Runtime kernel update v5.2 — matmul improvements; staged canary; fallback v5.1; rollback if p95>350ms or OOM>0.5%'
deploy-bot: depbot: preflight smoke scheduled at 2024-11-03T22:45:00Z. I'll post results. :gear:
maya: I'll be live for preflight. ping me if smoke shows regressions.
glen: Ops: I'm standing by to unpin regions if needed. :thumbsup:
alex: Thanks team. If anything changes post-smoke we'll reconvene here
